submitted.rationale: XRD shows one main phase across the line (peaks at Q ≈ 2.78, 3.22, 4.54, 5.33). A second phase, likely an Sb oxide (peaks at Q ≈ 1.91, 2.45, 3.64), appears only at the Sb-rich end. EQE at 2.7 eV rises sharply with Sb: 0.0003% at Sb 0.61 (index 22), 0.0067% at Sb 0.76 (index 27) and 0.0055% at Sb 0.81 (index 29). Index 27 had the highest measured EQE, which suggests the optimum is near Sb ≈ 0.76.
